housing.text: Authored a bill that streamlines and imposes deadlines on state-agency reviews of permits needed to begin predominantly residential development.
housing.quote: would require a state agency to comply with the above-described provisions relating to postentitlement phase permits applicable to a local agency

energy.text: Hayes says he would work to lower utility costs and support affordable, reliable energy while strengthening the power grid.
energy.quote: I am grateful for his support as we work to lower utility costs for working families.
